comparison.objective: Open a heavy laser-cutter lid bimanually until gas struts hold it; candidate adjusts and validates a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Symmetric two-hand lifting and controlled handoff to gas-strut support versus asymmetric precision tool use, counterholding, fine adjustment, and cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Lid fully open and self-supported without falling back versus two repeatable safe carriage stops and retained collar setting.
comparison.reason: Both involve damping-related hardware only incidentally; the record tests heavy hinged lifting, not damper adjustment.
